name: harmonized-v1-isotopic
description: Item-off baseline of D1: harmonized-v1 with the isotopic network (7Be, 9Be, 10Be, 10B, 11B from 12C and 16O) and the profile's isotopic ILLUSTRATIVE cross sections, so that 10Be/9Be is defined; every item off. A code that cannot express an item records the difference and its substitute (r3 5.5).

sources.spatial: not fixed by harmonized-v1; each code records its choice
sources.abundances: fixed by the parent list of theory:cr-secondary-ratio

cross_sections.ghost_threshold: off: ghost nuclei and tertiary chains off on both sides

output.differences_from_harmonized_v1: range 0.04-2000 GeV/n instead of 1-1000 (D1-1 needs 10Be/9Be from 0.05 GeV/n and B/C to 1000 GV); DRAGON2's energy grid is geometric with factor 1.2 (12.6 points per decade)
